items.title: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen
items.summary: We find that frontier LLMs are surprisingly good at natively reading and writing neural network weights, well past what we’d expect from humans or conventional algorithms.

items.title: The SEC Should Block Anthropic's IPO to Protect the Public
items.summary: If Anthropic goes public, workers, retail investors, and retirees will be left holding the bag when its bills come due, writes Matt Scherer.

items.title: Ubuntu still has not released patch for Linux 0day RCE in almost 3 weeks
items.summary: No patched kernels are available yet for 22.04, 24.04, or 26.04 despite a CVSS 9.8 rating.
items.titleZh: Ubuntu 近三周仍未发布 Linux 零日远程代码执行漏洞补丁
items.summaryZh: 尽管该漏洞的 CVSS 评分高达 9.8，22.04、24.04 和 26.04 版本仍没有可用的修补版内核。

items.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
items.titleZh: Anthropic 警告称，距离实现 RSI 能力（即 AI 自我构建）已非常接近
items.summaryZh: RSI 指的是 AI 在自我训练方面变得足够强大，进而引发 AI 能力急剧加速发展的阶段。在 AI 悲观派看来，RSI 意味着一场无法挽回的灾难。

items.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
items.summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
items.titleZh: 《纽约时报》等媒体起诉浏览器 Brave，指其涉嫌抓取内容
items.summaryZh: 《纽约时报》起诉注重隐私的浏览器公司 Brave，指控其抓取该报受版权保护的内容，并将内容非法分发给 Anthropic 和 Perplexity 等客户。
